title: Make logical path IDs the sole durable path authority
migration_impact: Store logical path IDs in durable records, resolve them through one authority, and migrate aliases through dual-read/single-write parity receipts with declared sunset releases.
release_note_impact: Package-excluded repository migration; maintainer documentation must name canonical IDs, aliases, parity receipts, and sunset status.

backport_disposition.factorio-2.1: canonical logical path resolver and single-write policy on dev
backport_disposition.factorio-2.0: reuse the package-excluded resolver for reconstruction and evidence without changing published package bytes
